text:
This photo shows leftovers rather than a full meal, so I estimated what remains on each dish.

- Half a sesame bagel sandwich with egg and cheese, partly eaten: about 150 g, roughly 330 kcal.
- Scraps on the left plate (chicken, vegetables, basil, chili): about 40 g, roughly 50 kcal.
- Bowl residue (fruit juices, a grape, a blueberry): about 30 g, roughly 25 kcal.
- Orange juice left in the glass: about 40 g, roughly 18 kcal. I counted it because it is edible.

That comes to about 260 g and about 420 kcal.
